ja.title: ガザのクリニック患者が紛争中に皮膚疾患を報告
ja.dek: Bioengineer.orgによると、ガザの皮膚科クリニックの患者のほとんどが、紛争中に皮膚疾患を発症したと報告している

ko.dek: 바이오엔지니어.org에 따르면 가자 피부과 클리닉 환자 대다수가 분쟁 중에 피부 질환이 시작되었다고 보고했다.

en.title: Zelensky stated Starshield restrictions continue on frontline
en.dek: EA WorldView reported that Zelensky stated Starshield restrictions continue on the frontline during the Ukraine War, Day 1,724.

de.title: Zelenski: Starshield-Beschränkungen bleiben an der Front bestehen
de.dek: EA WorldView berichtete, dass Zelenski erklärte, die Starshield-Beschränkungen im Ukraine-Krieg an Tag 1.724 an der Front fortbestehen.

fr.title: Zelensky : les restrictions Starshield persistent sur la ligne de front
fr.dek: EA WorldView rapporte que Zelensky a déclaré que les restrictions Starshield continuent sur le front pendant la guerre en Ukraine, jour 1 724.

es.title: Zelenski afirma que las restricciones de Starshield continúan en la línea del frente

it.title: Zelensky: le restrizioni Starshield continuano sul fronte

pt.title: Zelensky afirma que as restrições da Starshield continuam na linha da frente
